dz: 艾莉娅·普尔切里亚宣誓贞操并被封为"奥古斯塔"(Augusta),从而成为她13岁的弟弟特奥多修斯二世在前任摄政王去世后成为拜占庭帝国的摄政.
de: Aelia Pulcheria takes a vow of chastity and is proclaimed Augusta, thus becoming the regent of the Byzantine Empire for her 13-year-old brother Theodosius II after the death of the previous regent, praefect Anthemius.
